instance.note: the original instance of v1-v5; inputs are data/ unchanged

physical.state_observer: native coordinate AD of the trained curl-potential network

scope: Registered per-evaluation throughput of the complete C36 objective and its 50,692-entry parameter gradient on one GH200: the analytic engine against three external coordinate-derivative backends that produce the same 36-channel network state (nested PyTorch autograd, torch.func jacfwd, collapsed jet). Gate, curl, consumer and loss are the unchanged C36 code in every method, and every external parameter gradient is autograd. No training, no physical observation and no solve speedup claim.

methods.analytic: box376.potential_objective with the packed activation and its analytic transpose (the trainers' engine)
methods.nested_ad: box376.external_c36.raw_nested_ad: nested scalar-coordinate PyTorch autograd over the batch, as an ordinary PINN code writes it
methods.func_jacfwd: box376.external_c36.raw_func_jacfwd: torch.func jacfwd nested to third order plus the Hessian of the spatial Laplacian, vectorized with vmap
methods.jet_collapsed: box376.external_c36.raw_jet_collapsed: Dangel et al. collapsed Taylor mode for the value, spatial first derivatives and spatial Laplacian, first-order jet for dt; remaining derivatives by autograd (the Ethier and 2D adapter convention)

jet_snapshot.distribution: shipped in the execution packet, not in this repository

surrogate: F~(d) = F0 + J d_s + v d_t + (K d_s) d_t from the prepared geometry state; exact to every order the state uses because the features are affine in space and the state needs one time derivative; the elementwise form requires axis-aligned geometry, checked once per geometry (box376.external_c36.assert_axis_aligned)

variant_definitions.eager: Python evaluation of the objective and its parameter gradient
variant_definitions.compiled: analytic only: torch.compile of the packed activation and transpose (the trainers' compiled engine)
variant_definitions.traced: external only: the complete evaluation with one parameter gradient per chunk traced once with make_fx over a persistent parameter leaf (the Ethier pattern), run without torch.compile
variant_definitions.graph: the compiled (analytic) or traced (external) callable captured in a CUDA Graph

excluded_variants.torch.compile of the make_fx trace: development probe: compiling took 19 min and the call failed (Attempt to trace generator)
excluded_variants.torch.func grad_and_value compiled with: development probe and CPU fixture: dynamo raises an internal assertion of PyTorch 2.14.1 (_fw_primal under nested functorch levels)

throughput.selection_rule: per method, the candidate with the shortest selection time among those that build, run and pass the dense parameter-AD check (and, for compiled, traced and graph, the check after an in-place parameter change); failures and out-of-memory chunks are recorded and dropped
throughput.timing_rule: for each timing initialization, each method's eager and selected variants are rebuilt at the selected chunk, checked against dense parameter AD, called once, then timed in windows of ceil(10 s / selection time) evaluations; the per-variant statistic is the median window time per evaluation

ratios.matched_eager: method eager / analytic eager, per initialization, geometric mean over the two

predictions.best_vs_best: not predicted: no external traced or graph variant ran in development
predictions.basis: development probes on the development initialization: analytic eager 3.83 s, graph 0.133 s; func_jacfwd eager 3.8-5.7 s; jet_collapsed eager 33.0 s; nested_ad eager 350 s

throughput.feasibility_rule: projected solve seconds = 7,000 evaluations x the slower initialization's median of the selected variant + 7,800 s (two observations and setup); a method that fits 17,100 s (a 5 h job less 900 s) may be proposed for a separate paired solve registration with the user's go-ahead; otherwise only the projection is reported
caveats: jet_collapsed computes only the value, first derivatives and Laplacian by Taylor mode; the third derivatives, the Hessian of the Laplacian and the time-mixed terms are nested autograd, which dominates its cost; no Taylor producer of order three or more is implemented
nested_ad needs about 96 GB at chunk 512 in development and stays a throughput-only arm
ratios against a CUDA Graph replay mix execution mode with representation; the matched-eager ratio separates them

execution.allocation: one job, one GH200, 16 CPUs, 128 GiB host memory, 3 hours maximum
